object
 description: >-
 A tool result in scope (every result, or only toolName's) whose
 conten
t matches EVERY pattern (all within one result) occurred at\n least min (default 1) and at most max times. min and max
count\n MATCHING results, not all results: min 0, max 0 means no result\n matches. The content is the result
's text, then structuredContent,\n then its JSON output part (JSON as canonical JSON), or, with path,\n the
value at that key in structuredContent (in the JSON output part\n when there is no structuredContent). isError results
are included. A\n result whose text was truncated for storage (when path is omitted),\n or whose subject exc
eeds 100000 characters, is unreadable; so are\n results an incomplete capture did not record. A verdict they could\n

decide is unscored.
